title: How to Sell Art on Shopify: A Ready-Made Store for Artists | Impression #Shorts
description:
How to sell art on Shopify: let buyers see the art in their room first. A ready-made Shopify theme for artists and galleries: Impression, Artistic preset. We tapped through its real demo:
• A real room with the art already on the wall
• One tap shows everything in it: the art and the decor
• Pick the size and the frame that fit the wall
• Swipe to another room: new art, new decor, ready to shop
• Every artwork shows how it looks at home

You don't have to build any of this. We already did, so your gallery is ready on day one.

Impression is a ready-made store for artists and galleries in the official Shopify Theme Store. One payment, yours forever. Try it free with no time limit — you pay only when you publish your store.

🔗 Link to the theme is in our channel profile.
